name: Michael
method: Built-in app browser, 30 Oct 2026: loaded only the public Kaggle profile and competitions pages, one wait of several seconds after each load, no refresh loops, no block or rate limit seen. Page text read, competition list checked by screenshot, join date read from the profile tooltip, avatar read from the page's own avatar element. ARC standings read from the already-cited public board mirror (read-only GET, 30 Oct 2026, snapshot time inside the file). An older draft evidence file did not exist, so nothing was carried over.
